#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Deploy script: creates a release tar.gz archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories.

set -euo pipefail

# Determine a name for the archive (e.g., project-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.tar.gz)

    --exclude="node_modules/*" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude=".git/*" \
    .

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Deploy script: creates a release tar.gz archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories.

set -euo pipefail

# Pre-deployment validation: ensure all env vars in .env.test have non-empty values
ENV_FILE=".env.test"
if [[ ! -f "${ENV_FILE}" ]]; then
  echo "Error: ${ENV_FILE} not found."
  exit 1
fi

missing_vars=()
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
  # Trim leading/trailing whitespace
  line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"  # Remove leading spaces
  line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"   # Remove trailing spaces
  # Skip empty lines and comments
  [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
  # Split on first =
  key="${line%%=*}"
  value="${line#*=}"
  # Strip surrounding quotes
  value="${value%\"}"
  value="${value#\"}"
  value="${value%\'}"
  value="${value#\'}"
  if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
    missing_vars+=("$key")
  fi
done < "$ENV_FILE"

if (( ${#missing_vars[@]} )); then
  echo "Error: The following environment variables are missing values in ${ENV_FILE}:"
  printf ' - %s\n' "${missing_vars[@]}"
  exit 1
fi

# Send the full .env.test config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
echo "Posting deployment config to orchestrator..."
json_body="{"
first=true
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
  # Skip empty lines and comments (should already be filtered)
  [[ -z "$key" || "$key" == \#* ]] && continue
  key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
  value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

  value=${value//\"/\\\"}

    first=false
  else
    json_body+=","
  fi
  json_body+="\"$key\":\"$value\""
 done < "$ENV_FILE"

  http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config || {
  echo "Failed to POST deployment config to orchestrator"
  exit 1
}

# Determine a name for the archive (e.g., project-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.tar.gz)

    --exclude=".git/*" \

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Exit immediately if a command exits with a non-zero status.
set -e

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pre‑deployment validation: ensure required environment variables are set
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ ! -f .env.test ]]; then
  echo "Error: .env.test file not found in the project root." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# Load variables from .env.test into the script's environment
set -a
source .env.test
set +a

# Verify each variable has a non‑empty value
missing_vars=()
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
  # Skip comments and empty lines
  [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
  [[ "$key" =~ ^# ]] && continue
  # Trim whitespace from key
  key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
  if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
    missing_vars+=("$key")
  fi
done < <(grep -v '^\s*$' .env.test | grep -v '^\s*#')
if (( ${#missing_vars[@]} )); then
  echo "Error: The following required environment variables are missing or empty:" >&2
  for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
    echo "  - $var" >&2
  done
  exit 1
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Send the full .env.test contents as JSON to the deployment orchestrator
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # Build JSON object from .env.test (ignore comments/blank lines)

  echo "Error: $ENV_FILE not found."
  exit 1

# shellcheck source=/dev/null

  done < .env.test

} > "$json_file"

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Pre-deployment validation: ensure required environment variables are set
# Reads .env.test and checks each key has a non‑empty value.
validate_env() {
  local env_file=".env.test"
  if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
    echo "Error: $env_file not found."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Validating environment variables in $env_file..."
  local missing=0
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n $line ]]; do
    # Skip comments and empty lines
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    # Extract key and value (allow values with = after first =)
    key="${line%%=*}"
    value="${line#*=}"
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
      echo "Error: Variable '$key' is empty or not set in $env_file"
      missing=1
    fi
  done < "$env_file"
  if (( missing )); then
    echo "Environment validation failed."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "All required environment variables are set."
}

# Call validation before proceeding
validate_env

    key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d ' \t')
    value=$(echo "$value" | tr -d ' \t')
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
      echo "Error: Environment variable $key is not set in .env.test"

validate_env() {
  local env_file=".env.test"

  if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
    echo "⚠️  Validation skipped: $env_file not found."
    return
  fi

    # Trim leading/trailing whitespace
    line="${line##*( )}"   # remove leading spaces
    line="${line%%*( )}"   # remove trailing spaces
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue

    fi
  done < "$env_file"

  echo "✅ All required environment variables are set."
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Send validated configuration to deployment orchestrator
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# The full contents of .env.test are converted to a JSON object and
# POSTed to the orchestrator endpoint for audit compliance.
send_config() {
  local env_file=".env.test"
  local endpoint="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

  if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
    echo "⚠️  Config send skipped: $env_file not found."
    return
  fi

  # Build JSON from key=value lines, ignoring comments/blank lines
  local json_body
  json_body=$(awk -F= '
    $0 && $1 && $0 !~ /^#/ {
      # Escape double quotes and backslashes in the value
      gsub(/\\/, "\\\\", $2);
      gsub(/"/, "\\\"", $2);
      printf "\"%s\":\"%s\",", $1, $2
    }
  ' "$env_file" | sed 's/,$//')

  json_body="{${json_body}}"

  echo "📤 Sending configuration to orchestrator..."
  # Use curl to POST the JSON payload
  local http_status
  http_status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$json_body" "$endpoint")

  if [[ "$http_status" -ge 200 && "$http_status" -lt 300 ]]; then
    echo "✅ Configuration successfully sent (HTTP $http_status)."

    echo "❌ Failed to send configuration (HTTP $http_status)."

  fi
}

# Deploy script: validates environment variables from .env.test, posts the config for audit, and creates a tar.gz archive of the current directory

# ---------- Pre-deployment validation ----------
# Ensure .env.test exists
if [[ ! -f .env.test ]]; then
  echo "Error: .env.test file not found in the current directory."
  exit 1
fi

# Also build a JSON representation of the config
json_entries=()

  # Trim whitespace
  key=$(echo "$raw_key" | xargs)
  value=$(echo "$raw_value" | xargs)
  # Skip empty lines and comments
  [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
  [[ "$key" == \#* ]] && continue
  if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
    echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is missing a value in .env.test"
    exit 1

  export "$key"="$value"
